findings.produced: CURRENT_LOG_LEVEL: AtomicU8 + init_log_level()'s private RUST_LOG parser - a second, independent source of truth for the process log level
findings.consumer_location: get_log_level/set_log_level (level_control.rs:106-133) exported to gateway (src/gateway/handlers/logs.rs:26,74). Authoritative counterpart: reload::Handle<EnvFilter> in shared/logging/src/file_appender.rs:26,57-66,84-86 (EnvFilter::try_from_default_env). Evidence: `rg -n "CURRENT_LOG_LEVEL|init_log_level" src/` -> matches only inside level_control.rs; the mirror is fully self-contained.
findings.rationale: Parallel-implementation drift between src/logging and the shared/logging crate. (1) init_log_level parses only the first RUST_LOG directive (split(',').next() then split('=').next_back(), level_control.rs:90-97); RUST_LOG='warn,alephcore=debug' reports 'warn' while the real EnvFilter applies alephcore=debug - contradicts the doc at level_control.rs:106-108 claiming the reported level matches the backend filter. (2) set_log_level stores the atomic (level_control.rs:124) before calling aleph_logging::set_log_level (:125) and treats reload failure as non-fatal (:126-127); if logging is uninitialized, get_log_level reports a level the live filter never adopted. Silent divergence, currently low likelihood in the server (gateway starts after initialize_tracing) but the invariant is unenforced.
findings.proposed_change: Option (a): make level_control a pure facade - drop CURRENT_LOG_LEVEL/init_log_level and have get_log_level read the real filter (add a getter over FILTER_RELOAD in shared/logging, e.g. EnvFilter max_level_hint). Option (b): keep mirror but parse the highest directive for alephcore/aleph_server targets and roll back the atomic store when aleph_logging::set_log_level fails. Option (c): accept and document coarse-grained reporting. (a) is the single-source-of-truth fix.
findings.risk: (a) slightly changes get_log_level semantics (filter-derived) and needs an additive pub fn in shared/logging. (b) behavior-neutral. (c) free.
findings.verification: `rg -n "CURRENT_LOG_LEVEL" src/` -> all inside level_control.rs today; after (a) -> no matches.
